description: tools/fixtures/unified-lighting built with Web: Multithreaded off: no pthreads player and no service worker ship; served without COOP/COEP it runs single-thread. The player runs 3 frames after ready at a fixed 60 fps and quits (?quit-after=3&fixed-fps=60&after-ready), so the page is still while it is captured; software WebGL needs a long capture_timeout for this scene. The centre pixel is the grey floor between the middle cylinders.
